# Every key this machine can say, and the English under it.
#
# GENERATED. Do not edit by hand:
#   UPDATE_VOCABULARY_SNAPSHOT=1 cargo test -p alo-saying \
#     --test a_published_sentence_keeps_its_key
#
# It exists so that the English under a published key cannot move without somebody
# answering whether the meaning moved with it. A translation is keyed, so editing the
# English under a key leaves every translation of it rendering perfectly and saying
# something this product no longer says. ADR 0068 decides what may change; reworded.txt
# beside this file is where a rewording that kept its key says why the meaning held.
#
# One line per key: the key, a tab, then the English exactly as the crate declares it.
